segments.line: You trip on the top step at school.
Normally, that's a very bad day.
Today, you bounce. Down all twelve steps, like a rubber doll.
And at the bottom, you just stand up.
At the crosswalk, a delivery van bumps you at walking speed.
You fly thirty feet, spin twice in the air,
Your best friend Mo dares you to jump off his garage roof.
You roll once, dust off your hoodie, and walk away.
And floating over your head, there's something new.
A little green bar. It shrinks a bit every time you land.
Today, you run on video game physics.
But what would all of this really do to a human body?
And what happens when that little bar runs out?
